Create an image document

Source: R/create_image.R
create_image.Rd

Uploads an image to a series or event.

Usage

create_image(
  api,
  password,
  document_name,
  filepath,
  folder_id = NULL,
  event_id = NULL,
  push_notification = TRUE,
  push_notification_title = NULL,
  show_time = FALSE
)

Arguments

api

Your Sportity API key. Avoid writing it in scripts; store it in the SPORTITY_API environment variable and use Sys.getenv("SPORTITY_API").

password

The password of the series or event.

document_name

Name of the document, as shown in the app.

filepath

Path to the image file to upload.

folder_id

Id of the folder to add the document to. NULL (default) uses the root folder.

event_id

Id of the event to add the document to. NULL (default) adds it to the series.

push_notification

Send a push notification to users? Default TRUE.

push_notification_title

Title of the push notification. Defaults to document_name.

show_time

Show the time of the document in the app? Default FALSE.

Value

No return value, called for side effects. Prints a confirmation message.

Details

The document is added to the root folder of the series unless event_id and/or folder_id is given. Find these ids with list_active_events() and list_documents().

See also

Other document functions: create_folder(), create_link(), create_pdf(), create_text(), delete_document(), list_documents(), reorder_document()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
create_image(
  api = Sys.getenv("SPORTITY_API"),
  password = "my_password",
  document_name = "Course map",
  filepath = "course_map.png"
)
} # }
